format: Each claim has one of four statuses: PROVEN, PROVEN_WITH_LIMITATIONS, NOT_PROVEN, REJECTED. The wording must be precise. Stronger wording requires stronger evidence.

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis compiles goals into executable worker organizations.
claims.SCOPE: Deterministic GoalCompiler v0.1 + OrganizationPlanner + GenomeCompiler against 3 distinct non-trivial goals spanning software-engineering, diagnostic, and research domains.
LIMITATIONS: GoalCompiler is the deterministic v0.1 heuristic, NOT an LLM-backed understanding provider.
Organization is generated but not executed in Exp-A; execution is Exp-B.
N=3 cases; structural difference is qualitative, not statistical.
Comparator is NONE — no superiority claim over a fixed/static organization.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Genesis demonstrated that a meaningful goal compiles into a structurally varying executable worker organization in 3 verified missions spanning 3 distinct domains (software-engineering, diagnostic, research) under controlled conditions.

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis can execute generated organizations and independently verify outcomes.
claims.SCOPE: Deterministic full-chain execution (Goal → Requirements → Organization → Genome → Worker → Verification → Outcome) on a multi-artifact mission under scripted reasoning; complements Phase 4.8A/E real-LLM evidence.
LIMITATIONS: DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK reasoning; not real-LLM evidence (Phase 4.8A/E provide that).
MemoryComputer (in-memory filesystem); not real OpenBot.
N=3 deterministic runs; not statistical evidence of production-scale reliability.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Genesis executed a non-trivial multi-artifact mission end-to-end with 3/3 verified successes and 0 false successes under controlled conditions using deterministic reasoning; the same chain runs on real LLM + real OpenBot in Phase 4.8A/E.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis guarantees verified outcomes in production

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis can compose OpenBot, OpenDots and OpenMuse capabilities for a mission.
claims.SCOPE: Real three-pillar composition (OpenBot + OpenDots + OpenMuse) with real LLM (llm-glm-4-plus) across Phase 4.8A and 4.8E blind missions; Phase 4.8-probe confirmed cross-pillar flow.
LIMITATIONS: Phase 4.8C declared OpenMuse available but Invoked=false despite mission requesting durable delegation — observed limitation, not fixed.
OpenMuse in-flight recovery (H-22) NOT proven.
Single mission per composition case.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Genesis demonstrated real three-pillar capability composition (OpenBot + OpenDots + OpenMuse) with real LLM in 2 verified blind missions (Phase 4.8A, 4.8E) where cross-pillar flow produced verified artifacts.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis composes all three pillars reliably in production
Genesis reliably composes any capability combination

claims.SCOPE: Local reference MCP server; authorized workers invoke tools correctly; unauthorized workers are blocked with grant refusal and no false success.
LIMITATIONS: Local reference MCP server only; not a real third-party MCP server.
No production-scale MCP federation proven.
No universal MCP compatibility claim.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: MCP-based tool interoperability was demonstrated with a local reference MCP server: authorized workers invoke tools correctly and unauthorized workers are blocked, with no false success.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis integrates with any MCP server
Genesis fully supports MCP in production

claims.SCOPE: AG-UI v1.0 protocol emission; 13 ordered event types emitted; consumer reconstructs run; failure probe emits RUN_ERROR; no false success.
LIMITATIONS: In-process consumer only; not a real third-party AG-UI application.
No production-scale AG-UI streaming proven.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: AG-UI-compatible execution events are emitted by Genesis in correct AG-UI v1.0 protocol order, and a consumer can reconstruct the run including failure cases without false success.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis integrates seamlessly with all AG-UI applications

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis supports outbound A2A federation with an independent reference agent.
claims.SCOPE: A2A outbound federation against an independent local reference agent; 3 probes (success, failure, trust-boundary). The trust-boundary invariant (A2A RESULT ≠ VERIFIED GENESIS FACT) is proven.
LIMITATIONS: Outbound federation only — inbound federation deferred.
Reference agent uses no auth — production authentication not proven.
Only local reference-agent interoperability proven, not a real third-party A2A agent.
Polling-based (not streaming).
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Outbound A2A interoperability was demonstrated against an independent local reference agent. The trust-boundary invariant is proven: an external agent claiming success with wrong content does not become Genesis verified success.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis integrates seamlessly with all A2A agents
Genesis federates with arbitrary external agents in production

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis can optionally consume real Jev probabilistic decisions.
claims.SCOPE: Real Jev Decision Model (typesafe/jev-1.13) via OpenRouter Decisions API EU endpoint; positive causal proof (Jev decision causally wired into genome compilation, mission success, $0.000016296 observed); benchmark 27/29 correctness with 7 failure-truthfulness probes PASS.
LIMITATIONS: Jev is OPTIONAL — production default is RuleDecisionProvider.
Jev correctness NOT strictly superior to Rule (27/29 each; different failures).
Jev adds cost ($0.00738187 / 34 calls) and latency (avg 3448ms vs Rule 0.069ms).
No new Jev calls authorized in G6-05.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Real Jev Decision Model integration is proven: a real Jev decision (typesafe/jev-1.13 via OpenRouter Decisions API EU endpoint) is causally wired into Genesis genome compilation with mission success. Jev remains OPTIONAL; production default is RuleDecisionProvider.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Rule outperforms Jev based on the historical Router benchmark
Jev is the production default DecisionProvider
Genesis relies on Jev for bounded probabilistic decisions

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis learns reusable organizational patterns from validated experience.
claims.SCOPE: Bounded organizational learning loop: validated experiences → candidate generation → evaluation → pattern promotion → planner retrieval → pattern application, under scripted reasoning conditions.
LIMITATIONS: Scripted reasoning throughout Academy cohorts (provenance.source=synthetic on every Experience).
No real-LLM behavioral evidence of learning.
Only prefer-role:Sole Operator implemented in v0.1 planner.
N=14 training experiences (Cohort 001 + 002); small sample.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Genesis demonstrated a bounded organizational learning loop: validated experiences produce reusable organizational patterns that are retrieved and applied by the planner, under controlled scripted conditions.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis learns from real-LLM behavioral experience

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Applicable learned patterns can reduce organizational complexity while preserving correctness in controlled cases.
claims.SCOPE: Controlled experiment: same goal, provider, tools, runtime; only pattern availability varies. Treatment (prefer-role:Sole Operator available) collapsed 2-specialist baseline to 1 Sole Operator; verification correctness preserved.
LIMITATIONS: STRUCTURAL reduction (worker count), NOT behavioral (real-world cost).
Per Section 11: 'A reduction in worker count is not automatically proof of lower real-world cost.'
Control arm failed verification because scripted reasoning cannot coordinate across worker instances — this is a measurement artifact, not a real-world learning benefit.
N=3 deterministic runs per arm.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Under controlled scripted conditions, an applicable learned pattern reduced the planned organization from two workers to one. The treatment completed verification in 3/3 runs, while the control completed 0/3. The control was limited by scripted multi-worker coordination, so this experiment does not establish general execution superiority or preserved correctness.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Learning reliably reduces complexity in production

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis can reject non-applicable organizational patterns.
claims.SCOPE: Blind transfer experiment: research mission (applicable) retrieved 2 patterns; software-engineering mission (non-applicable) retrieved 0 patterns; no harmful transfer.
LIMITATIONS: Pattern retrieval is structural (intersection rule) — confirmatory, not active causal transfer.
G5-07 found 3 CONFIRMATORY_TRANSFER + 1 NON_APPLICABLE; 0 ACTIVE_TRANSFER.
Scripted reasoning throughout.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Genesis correctly retrieves applicable patterns for relevant unseen missions and correctly retrieves no pattern for non-applicable missions, with no harmful transfer in tested cases.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis actively transfers learning to all relevant missions
Genesis never applies a pattern incorrectly

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis prevents false-success claims in tested verification/failure scenarios.
claims.SCOPE: 5 failure-injection scenarios in G6-05 Exp-E (unknown action, missing artifact, wrong content, hash-mismatch, verification gate fails) all report failure truthfully; 8 G6-04 failure probes all PASS; 7 Jev failure-truthfulness probes all PASS.
LIMITATIONS: Deterministic failure injection; not exhaustive of all failure modes.
Real-provider failure modes (OpenBot disconnect, OpenMuse queue failure) covered by G6-01 hardening evidence, not G6-05 Exp-E.
No claim of zero false-success in production.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: Genesis prevented false-success claims across 5 deterministic failure-injection scenarios, 8 G6-04 failure probes, 7 Jev failure-truthfulness probes, and the A2A trust-boundary probe, with flight records preserved on failure in tested cases.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis guarantees no false-success in production

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis Engine can be reproduced from clean source without hidden development state.
claims.SCOPE: Two independent clean-room runs from commit cf92318 produced semantically identical results: typecheck PASS, lint PASS, 487/9/496 tests, smoke mission PASS with verified artifact. Zero env vars required.
LIMITATIONS: Deterministic core only — MemoryComputer, RuleDecisionProvider, DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK.
Real providers (OpenBot/OpenDots/OpenMuse/Jev) NOT exercised by clean-room run; their evidence lives in Phase 4.5–4.8E and G6-03B.
G6-04 commit cf92318 is the RC candidate; G6-05 commit 15243ef adds documentation only.
claims.APPROVED_PUBLIC_WORDING: The Genesis Engine can be taken from its authoritative GitHub repository, installed, configured, executed, verified, and reproduced in a clean environment without relying on hidden historical state. Two independent clean-room runs from the same commit produce semantically identical results.
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis has been reproduced in arbitrary environments

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis is production-ready for arbitrary autonomous software development.
LIMITATIONS: No evidence of arbitrary autonomous software development.
Genesis demonstrated bounded missions only.
Engine v1.0 is NOT declared (per Section 0).

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis reliably outperforms fixed multi-agent systems.
LIMITATIONS: No head-to-head benchmark against a fixed multi-agent system.
G6-05 Exp-C comparator is a controlled learning-disabled baseline, not a fixed multi-agent system.
Per Section 17: 'Do not deliberately sabotage the baseline.'
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis is more reliable than fixed teams

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis reduces API costs by a generalizable percentage.
LIMITATIONS: G6-05 Exp-C measured STRUCTURAL reduction (worker count), NOT real-world API cost.
Per Section 15: 'Do not convert reasoning calls into dollars without actual model pricing and usage data.'
Per Section 15: 'Do not claim token savings without token evidence.'
PROHIBITED_WORDING: Genesis reduces API costs by X percent

claims.CLAIM_TEXT: Genesis autonomously builds any requested application.
LIMITATIONS: No evidence of arbitrary application building.
Bounded missions only.
Engine v1.0 is NOT declared.

summary.strongest_claim_supported: C12 — Genesis Engine can be reproduced from clean source without hidden development state (E1 evidence).
summary.weakest_accepted_claim: C04/C05/C06 — reference integrations only, not production-scale (E3 evidence).
